cases_detail.sql: SELECT azoneName, COUNT(*) AS count FROM CLOUD_VM_NOVA GROUP BY azoneName
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM CLOUD_VM_NOVA
SELECT tenantName, COUNT(*) AS count FROM CLOUD_VM_NOVA GROUP BY tenantName ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT CLOUD_VM_NOVA.name AS vm_name, CLOUD_VM_NOVA.status, CLOUD_FLAVOR.vcpuSize, CLOUD_FLAVOR.ramSize, CLOUD_FLAVOR.diskSize FROM CLOUD_VM_NOVA INNER JOIN CLOUD_FLAVOR ON CLOUD_VM_NOVA.flavorId = CLOUD_FLAVOR.id
SELECT name, createdAt FROM CLOUD_VM_NOVA

SELECT CLOUD_VM_NOVA.name AS vm_name, CLOUD_VM_NOVA.status, CLOUD_FLAVOR.name AS flavor_name, CLOUD_FLAVOR.vcpuSize, CLOUD_FLAVOR.ramSize, CLOUD_FLAVOR.diskSize FROM CLOUD_VM_NOVA INNER JOIN CLOUD_FLAVOR ON CLOUD_VM_NOVA.flavorId = CLOUD_FLAVOR.id

SELECT CLOUD_FLAVOR.name AS flavor_name, CLOUD_FLAVOR.vcpuSize, CLOUD_FLAVOR.ramSize, CLOUD_FLAVOR.diskSize, COUNT(*) AS count FROM CLOUD_VM_NOVA INNER JOIN CLOUD_FLAVOR ON CLOUD_VM_NOVA.flavorId = CLOUD_FLAVOR.id GROUP BY CLOUD_FLAVOR.name, CLOUD_FLAVOR.vcpuSize, CLOUD_FLAVOR.ramSize, CLOUD_FLAVOR.diskSize ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT CLOUD_FLAVOR.name AS flavor_name, CLOUD_FLAVOR.vcpuSize, CLOUD_FLAVOR.ramSize, CLOUD_FLAVOR.diskSize, COUNT(*) AS count FROM CLOUD_VM_NOVA INNER JOIN CLOUD_FLAVOR ON CLOUD_VM_NOVA.flavorId = CLOUD_FLAVOR.id GROUP BY CLOUD_FLAVOR.name, CLOUD_FLAVOR.vcpuSize, CLOUD_FLAVOR.ramSize, CLOUD_FLAVOR.diskSize ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT CLOUD_FLAVOR.vcpuSize, CLOUD_FLAVOR.ramSize, CLOUD_FLAVOR.diskSize, COUNT(*) AS count FROM CLOUD_VM_NOVA INNER JOIN CLOUD_FLAVOR ON CLOUD_VM_NOVA.flavorId = CLOUD_FLAVOR.id GROUP BY CLOUD_FLAVOR.vcpuSize, CLOUD_FLAVOR.ramSize, CLOUD_FLAVOR.diskSize
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM CLOUD_VM_NOVA INNER JOIN CLOUD_FLAVOR ON CLOUD_VM_NOVA.flavorId = CLOUD_FLAVOR.id

SELECT tenantName, CLOUD_FLAVOR.name AS flavor_name, CLOUD_FLAVOR.vcpuSize, CLOUD_FLAVOR.ramSize, COUNT(*) AS count FROM CLOUD_VM_NOVA INNER JOIN CLOUD_FLAVOR ON CLOUD_VM_NOVA.flavorId = CLOUD_FLAVOR.id GROUP BY tenantName, CLOUD_FLAVOR.name, CLOUD_FLAVOR.vcpuSize, CLOUD_FLAVOR.ramSize

SELECT azoneName, CLOUD_VM_NOVA.name AS vm_name, CLOUD_FLAVOR.name AS flavor_name, CLOUD_VM_NOVA.status FROM CLOUD_VM_NOVA INNER JOIN CLOUD_FLAVOR ON CLOUD_VM_NOVA.flavorId = CLOUD_FLAVOR.id ORDER BY azoneName
SELECT vdcName, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_count FROM CLOUD_VM_NOVA GROUP BY vdcName

SELECT CLOUD_VM_NOVA.azoneName, CLOUD_VM_NOVA.name AS vm_name, CLOUD_VM_NOVA.privateIps, CLOUD_VM_NOVA.tenantName, CLOUD_HOST.name AS host_name
FROM CLOUD_VM_NOVA
INNER JOIN CLOUD_HOST ON CLOUD_VM_NOVA.hostId = CLOUD_HOST.id
GROUP BY CLOUD_VM_NOVA.azoneName, CLOUD_VM_NOVA.name, CLOUD_VM_NOVA.privateIps, CLOUD_VM_NOVA.tenantName, CLOUD_HOST.name
ORDER BY CLOUD_VM_NOVA.azoneName

SELECT tenantName, name AS instance_name, 'ECS' AS type, privateIps AS ip FROM CLOUD_VM_NOVA UNION ALL SELECT tenantName, name AS instance_name, 'Volume' AS type, '' AS ip FROM CLOUD_VOLUME UNION ALL SELECT tenantName, name AS instance_name, 'ELB' AS type, ip AS ip FROM CLOUD_ELB

SELECT CLOUD_FLOATING_IPS.floatingIpAddress AS floating_ip, CLOUD_VM_NOVA.name AS vm_name, CLOUD_VM_NOVA.privateIps FROM CLOUD_FLOATING_IPS INNER JOIN CLOUD_VM_NOVA ON CLOUD_FLOATING_IPS.fixedIpAddress = CLOUD_VM_NOVA.privateIps

SELECT SYS_DeployNode.name AS node_name, SYS_DeployNode.mgmtIp AS node_ip, SYS_CloudService.name AS cloud_service_name FROM SYS_DeployNode INNER JOIN SYS_DeployInstance ON SYS_DeployNode.id = SYS_DeployInstance.deployNodeId INNER JOIN SYS_DeployComponent ON SYS_DeployInstance.deployComponentId = SYS_DeployComponent.id INNER JOIN SYS_Service ON SYS_DeployComponent.serviceId = SYS_Service.id INNER JOIN SYS_CloudService ON SYS_Service.cloudServiceId = SYS_CloudService.id

SELECT CLOUD_HOST.name AS host_name, CLOUD_VM_NOVA.name AS vm_name, CLOUD_VM_NOVA.status, CLOUD_VM_NOVA.privateIps FROM CLOUD_CLUSTER INNER JOIN M_ClusterContainsPhyHost ON CLOUD_CLUSTER.id = M_ClusterContainsPhyHost.source_Instance_Id INNER JOIN CLOUD_HOST ON M_ClusterContainsPhyHost.target_Instance_Id = CLOUD_HOST.id INNER JOIN CLOUD_VM_NOVA ON CLOUD_HOST.id = CLOUD_VM_NOVA.hostId

SELECT CLOUD_HOST.name AS host_name, CLOUD_HOST.ipAddress, COUNT(CLOUD_VM_NOVA.id) AS vm_count FROM CLOUD_VM_NOVA INNER JOIN CLOUD_HOST ON CLOUD_VM_NOVA.hostId = CLOUD_HOST.id GROUP BY CLOUD_HOST.name, CLOUD_HOST.ipAddress
SELECT CLOUD_VM_NOVA.status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM CLOUD_HOST INNER JOIN CLOUD_VM_NOVA ON CLOUD_HOST.id = CLOUD_VM_NOVA.hostId GROUP BY CLOUD_VM_NOVA.status

SELECT CLOUD_VM_NOVA.name AS vm_name, CLOUD_HOST.name AS host_name, CLOUD_HOST.ipAddress AS host_ip, SYS_X86Server.name AS server_name, SYS_X86Server.id AS server_id FROM CLOUD_VM_NOVA INNER JOIN CLOUD_HOST ON CLOUD_VM_NOVA.hostId = CLOUD_HOST.id INNER JOIN SYS_X86Server ON CLOUD_HOST.serverId = SYS_X86Server.id
SELECT CLOUD_VM_NOVA.name AS vm_name, CLOUD_HOST.name AS host_name, CLOUD_HOST.ipAddress AS host_ip FROM CLOUD_VM_NOVA INNER JOIN CLOUD_HOST ON CLOUD_VM_NOVA.hostId = CLOUD_HOST.id
SELECT name, clusterName, azoneName FROM CLOUD_VM_NOVA
SELECT CLOUD_HOST.name AS host_name, SYS_X86Server.cpuModel, SYS_X86Server.manufacturer, SYS_X86Server.cpuArch FROM CLOUD_HOST INNER JOIN SYS_X86Server ON CLOUD_HOST.serverId = SYS_X86Server.id

SELECT CLOUD_CLUSTER.name AS cluster_name, COUNT(DISTINCT CLOUD_HOST.id) AS host_count, SUM(CLOUD_HOST.totalVcpuCores) AS total_vcpu, SUM(CASE WHEN CLOUD_VM_NOVA.status = 'active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_vm_count FROM CLOUD_CLUSTER INNER JOIN M_ClusterContainsPhyHost ON CLOUD_CLUSTER.id = M_ClusterContainsPhyHost.source_Instance_Id INNER JOIN CLOUD_HOST ON M_ClusterContainsPhyHost.target_Instance_Id = CLOUD_HOST.id INNER JOIN CLOUD_VM_NOVA ON CLOUD_HOST.id = CLOUD_VM_NOVA.hostId GROUP BY CLOUD_CLUSTER.name

SELECT CLOUD_CLUSTER.name AS cluster_name, CLOUD_HOST.name AS host_name, CLOUD_HOST.ipAddress AS host_ip, CLOUD_VM_NOVA.name AS vm_name, CLOUD_VM_NOVA.status AS vm_status, CLOUD_VOLUME.name AS volume_name, CLOUD_VOLUME.size AS volume_size FROM CLOUD_CLUSTER INNER JOIN M_ClusterContainsPhyHost ON CLOUD_CLUSTER.id = M_ClusterContainsPhyHost.source_Instance_Id INNER JOIN CLOUD_HOST ON M_ClusterContainsPhyHost.target_Instance_Id = CLOUD_HOST.id INNER JOIN CLOUD_VM_NOVA ON CLOUD_HOST.id = CLOUD_VM_NOVA.hostId INNER JOIN R_VOLUME_MOUNTON_VM ON CLOUD_VM_NOVA.id = R_VOLUME_MOUNTON_VM.vmId INNER JOIN CLOUD_VOLUME ON R_VOLUME_MOUNTON_VM.volumeId = CLOUD_VOLUME.id

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CLOUD_CLUSTER.id) AS cluster_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CLOUD_HOST.id) AS host_count FROM CLOUD_HOST INNER JOIN M_ClusterContainsPhyHost ON CLOUD_HOST.id = M_ClusterContainsPhyHost.target_Instance_Id INNER JOIN CLOUD_CLUSTER ON M_ClusterContainsPhyHost.source_Instance_Id = CLOUD_CLUSTER.id
SELECT name, privateIps, status FROM CLOUD_VM_NOVA
SELECT name, privateIps, status FROM CLOUD_VM_NOVA
SELECT tenantName, name, privateIps FROM CLOUD_VM_NOVA ORDER BY tenantName
SELECT CLOUD_VM_NOVA.name AS vm_name, CLOUD_VM_NOVA.privateIps AS private_ips, CLOUD_FLAVOR.name AS flavor_name FROM CLOUD_VM_NOVA LEFT JOIN CLOUD_FLAVOR ON CLOUD_VM_NOVA.flavorId = CLOUD_FLAVOR.id
SELECT 'ECS' AS type, vdcName, COUNT(*) AS count FROM CLOUD_VM_NOVA GROUP BY vdcName

SELECT a.vdcName, a.ecs_count, b.volume_count, b.total_volume_size FROM (SELECT vdcName, COUNT(*) AS ecs_count FROM CLOUD_VM_NOVA GROUP BY vdcName) a LEFT JOIN (SELECT vdcName, COUNT(*) AS volume_count, SUM(size) AS total_volume_size FROM CLOUD_VOLUME GROUP BY vdcName) b ON a.vdcName = b.vdcName
SELECT 'ECS' AS type, COUNT(*) AS count FROM CLOUD_VM_NOVA UNION ALL SELECT 'Volume' AS type, COUNT(*) AS count FROM CLOUD_VOLUME UNION ALL SELECT 'VPC' AS type, COUNT(*) AS count FROM CLOUD_ROUTER

SELECT 'ECS' AS type, vdcName, COUNT(*) AS count FROM CLOUD_VM_NOVA GROUP BY vdcName
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Volume' AS type, vdcName, COUNT(*) AS count FROM CLOUD_VOLUME GROUP BY vdcName
UNION ALL
SELECT 'VPC' AS type, vdcName, COUNT(*) AS count FROM CLOUD_ROUTER GROUP BY vdcName
SELECT SYS_X86Server.cpuArch AS cpu_arch, COUNT(*) AS count FROM CLOUD_HOST INNER JOIN SYS_X86Server ON CLOUD_HOST.serverId = SYS_X86Server.id GROUP BY SYS_X86Server.cpuArch

SELECT SYS_X86Server.cpuArch AS cpu_arch, COUNT(*) AS count
FROM CLOUD_HOST
INNER JOIN SYS_X86Server ON CLOUD_HOST.serverId = SYS_X86Server.id
GROUP BY SYS_X86Server.cpuArch
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM CLOUD_HOST GROUP BY status
SELECT cpuArch, COUNT(*) AS count FROM SYS_X86Server GROUP BY cpuArch

SELECT SYS_X86Server.cpuArch AS cpu_arch, CLOUD_HOST.azoneName AS azone_name, COUNT(CLOUD_VM_NOVA.id) AS vm_count FROM SYS_X86Server INNER JOIN CLOUD_HOST ON SYS_X86Server.id = CLOUD_HOST.serverId INNER JOIN CLOUD_VM_NOVA ON CLOUD_HOST.id = CLOUD_VM_NOVA.hostId GROUP BY SYS_X86Server.cpuArch, CLOUD_HOST.azoneName
SELECT name, ipAddress, totalVmemoryMB, allocatedVmemoryMB, totalVmemoryMB - allocatedVmemoryMB AS remaining_memory FROM CLOUD_HOST ORDER BY remaining_memory DESC LIMIT 3

SELECT CLOUD_HOST.name AS host_name, CLOUD_HOST.ipAddress AS ip_address, CLOUD_HOST.totalVcpuCores AS total_vcpu, CLOUD_HOST.allocatedVcpuCores AS allocated_vcpu, SYS_X86Server.cpuArch AS cpu_arch FROM CLOUD_HOST INNER JOIN SYS_X86Server ON CLOUD_HOST.serverId = SYS_X86Server.id

SELECT CLOUD_HOST.name AS host_name, CLOUD_HOST.ipAddress AS ip_address, CLOUD_HOST.totalCpu AS total_cpu, COUNT(CLOUD_VM_NOVA.id) AS vm_count FROM CLOUD_HOST INNER JOIN CLOUD_VM_NOVA ON CLOUD_HOST.id = CLOUD_VM_NOVA.hostId GROUP BY CLOUD_HOST.name, CLOUD_HOST.ipAddress, CLOUD_HOST.totalCpu
SELECT name AS node_name, mgmtIp AS mgmt_ip FROM SYS_DeployNode

SELECT CLOUD_VM_NOVA.vdcName AS vdc_name, CLOUD_VM_NOVA.name AS vm_name, CLOUD_VM_NOVA.privateIps AS private_ips, SYS_CloudService.indexName AS cloud_service_name FROM CLOUD_VM_NOVA INNER JOIN SYS_DeployNode ON CLOUD_VM_NOVA.id = SYS_DeployNode.vmId INNER JOIN SYS_DeployInstance ON SYS_DeployNode.id = SYS_DeployInstance.deployNodeId INNER JOIN SYS_DeployComponent ON SYS_DeployInstance.deployComponentId = SYS_DeployComponent.id INNER JOIN SYS_Service ON SYS_DeployComponent.serviceId = SYS_Service.id INNER JOIN SYS_CloudService ON SYS_Service.cloudServiceId = SYS_CloudService.id ORDER BY CLOUD_VM_NOVA.vdcName
SELECT logicalRegionName, COUNT(*) AS count FROM SYS_X86Server GROUP BY logicalRegionName
SELECT manufacturer, COUNT(*) AS count FROM SYS_X86Server GROUP BY manufacturer

SELECT CLOUD_CLUSTER.name AS cluster_name, CLOUD_HOST.name AS host_name, CLOUD_HOST.ipAddress AS ip_address, CLOUD_HOST.allocatedVcpuCores, CLOUD_HOST.totalVcpuCores, CAST(CLOUD_HOST.allocatedVcpuCores AS FLOAT) / CLOUD_HOST.totalVcpuCores AS allocation_rate FROM CLOUD_HOST INNER JOIN M_ClusterContainsPhyHost ON CLOUD_HOST.id = M_ClusterContainsPhyHost.target_Instance_Id INNER JOIN CLOUD_CLUSTER ON M_ClusterContainsPhyHost.source_Instance_Id = CLOUD_CLUSTER.id
SELECT class_Name, COUNT(*) AS count FROM SYS_Device GROUP BY class_Name
SELECT SYS_X86Server.hostName AS name, SYS_X86Server.hostIpAddress AS ip_address, SYS_X86Server.cpuArch AS cpu_arch, SYS_X86Server.cpuCores AS cpu_cores FROM SYS_X86Server
SELECT logicalRegionName, COUNT(*) AS count FROM SYS_X86Server GROUP BY logicalRegionName
SELECT class_Name, COUNT(*) AS count FROM SYS_Device GROUP BY class_Name

SELECT DISTINCT SYS_DeployNode.name AS node_name, SYS_DeployNode.id AS node_id, SYS_DeployNode.hostName AS host_name, SYS_DeployNode.mgmtIp AS mgmt_ip FROM SYS_CloudService INNER JOIN SYS_Service ON SYS_CloudService.id = SYS_Service.cloudServiceId INNER JOIN SYS_DeployComponent ON SYS_Service.id = SYS_DeployComponent.serviceId INNER JOIN SYS_DeployInstance ON SYS_DeployComponent.id = SYS_DeployInstance.deployComponentId INNER JOIN SYS_DeployNode ON SYS_DeployInstance.deployNodeId = SYS_DeployNode.id

SELECT DISTINCT SYS_DeployNode.name AS node_name, SYS_DeployNode.hostClass AS host_class
FROM SYS_CloudService
INNER JOIN SYS_Service ON SYS_CloudService.id = SYS_Service.cloudServiceId
INNER JOIN SYS_DeployComponent ON SYS_Service.id = SYS_DeployComponent.serviceId
INNER JOIN SYS_DeployInstance ON SYS_DeployComponent.id = SYS_DeployInstance.deployComponentId
INNER JOIN SYS_DeployNode ON SYS_DeployInstance.deployNodeId = SYS_DeployNode.id
SELECT CLOUD_VOLUME.status AS status, CLOUD_VOLUME.volumeTypeId AS type_name, COUNT(*) AS count FROM CLOUD_VOLUME GROUP BY CLOUD_VOLUME.status, CLOUD_VOLUME.volumeTypeId
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS count, MAX(size) AS max_size FROM CLOUD_VOLUME GROUP BY status ORDER BY count DESC
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN lower(CAST(bootable AS TEXT)) IN ('true','1') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS bootable_percentage FROM CLOUD_VOLUME;
SELECT vdcName, COUNT(*) AS count, SUM(size) AS total_size FROM CLOUD_VOLUME GROUP BY vdcName
SELECT vdcName, COUNT(*) AS count, SUM(size) AS total_size FROM CLOUD_VOLUME GROUP BY vdcName
SELECT CLOUD_VOLUME.name AS name, CLOUD_VOLUME.size AS size, CLOUD_VOLUME.status AS status, 'N/A' AS type_name FROM CLOUD_VOLUME

SELECT CLOUD_VOLUME.name AS volume_name, CLOUD_VOLUME.size AS size_gb, CLOUD_VOLUME.bootable AS bootable, CLOUD_VOLUME.status AS status FROM CLOUD_VM_NOVA INNER JOIN R_VOLUME_MOUNTON_VM ON CLOUD_VM_NOVA.id = R_VOLUME_MOUNTON_VM.vmId INNER JOIN CLOUD_VOLUME ON R_VOLUME_MOUNTON_VM.volumeId = CLOUD_VOLUME.id

SELECT CLOUD_VOLUME.bootable AS bootable, CLOUD_VOLUME.name AS volume_name, CLOUD_VOLUME.size AS size FROM CLOUD_VM_NOVA INNER JOIN R_VOLUME_MOUNTON_VM ON CLOUD_VM_NOVA.id = R_VOLUME_MOUNTON_VM.vmId INNER JOIN CLOUD_VOLUME ON R_VOLUME_MOUNTON_VM.volumeId = CLOUD_VOLUME.id ORDER BY CLOUD_VOLUME.bootable

SELECT CLOUD_VOLUME.name AS volume_name, CLOUD_VOLUME.size AS size, CLOUD_VOLUME.status AS status, CLOUD_VM_NOVA.name AS vm_name FROM CLOUD_VOLUME INNER JOIN R_VOLUME_MOUNTON_VM ON CLOUD_VOLUME.id = R_VOLUME_MOUNTON_VM.volumeId INNER JOIN CLOUD_VM_NOVA ON R_VOLUME_MOUNTON_VM.vmId = CLOUD_VM_NOVA.id
SELECT name, status FROM CLOUD_VOLUME

SELECT CLOUD_VOLUME.name AS volume_name, CLOUD_VOLUME.size AS size FROM CLOUD_VM_NOVA INNER JOIN R_VOLUME_MOUNTON_VM ON CLOUD_VM_NOVA.id = R_VOLUME_MOUNTON_VM.vmId INNER JOIN CLOUD_VOLUME ON R_VOLUME_MOUNTON_VM.volumeId = CLOUD_VOLUME.id ORDER BY CLOUD_VOLUME.size DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT name, totalCapacityGB, freeCapacityGB, provisionedCapacityGB, (totalCapacityGB - freeCapacityGB) AS used_capacity, ROUND((totalCapacityGB - freeCapacityGB) * 100.0 / totalCapacityGB, 2) AS usage_rate, ROUND(provisionedCapacityGB * 100.0 / totalCapacityGB, 2) AS over_subscription_ratio FROM CLOUD_STORAGE_POOL

SELECT azoneName, SUM(totalCapacityGB) AS total_capacity, SUM(freeCapacityGB) AS free_capacity, (SUM(totalCapacityGB) - SUM(freeCapacityGB)) AS used_capacity, ROUND((SUM(totalCapacityGB) - SUM(freeCapacityGB)) * 100.0 / SUM(totalCapacityGB), 2) AS usage_rate FROM CLOUD_STORAGE_POOL GROUP BY azoneName

SELECT name, totalCapacityGB, freeCapacityGB, (totalCapacityGB - freeCapacityGB) AS used_capacity, ROUND((totalCapacityGB - freeCapacityGB) * 100.0 / totalCapacityGB, 2) AS usage_rate FROM CLOUD_STORAGE_POOL ORDER BY usage_rate DESC
SELECT name, bucketName, managedStatus FROM CLOUD_OBS_BUCKET
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count FROM CLOUD_OBS_BUCKET
SELECT tenantName, COUNT(*) AS count FROM CLOUD_OBS_BUCKET GROUP BY tenantName
SELECT vdcName, AVG(size) AS avg_size, MAX(size) AS max_size FROM CLOUD_VOLUME GROUP BY vdcName

SELECT CLOUD_VM_NOVA.name AS vm_name, COUNT(*) AS volume_count FROM CLOUD_VM_NOVA INNER JOIN R_VOLUME_MOUNTON_VM ON CLOUD_VM_NOVA.id = R_VOLUME_MOUNTON_VM.vmId INNER JOIN CLOUD_VOLUME ON R_VOLUME_MOUNTON_VM.volumeId = CLOUD_VOLUME.id GROUP BY CLOUD_VM_NOVA.name ORDER BY volume_count DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT vendorName, SUM(totalCapacityGB) AS total_capacity, SUM(freeCapacityGB) AS free_capacity FROM CLOUD_STORAGE_POOL GROUP BY vendorName
SELECT flavorCode, COUNT(*) AS count FROM CLOUD_GAUSSDB_INSTANCE GROUP BY flavorCode
SELECT vdcName, COUNT(*) AS instance_count, SUM(dataVolumeSizeInGBs) AS total_storage FROM CLOUD_GAUSSDB_INSTANCE GROUP BY vdcName

SELECT CLOUD_GAUSSDB_INSTANCE.name AS instance_name, CLOUD_GAUSSDB_NODE.name AS node_name, CLOUD_VM_NOVA.name AS vm_name, CLOUD_VM_NOVA.privateIps AS vm_ip FROM CLOUD_GAUSSDB_INSTANCE INNER JOIN CLOUD_GAUSSDB_NODE ON CLOUD_GAUSSDB_INSTANCE.id = CLOUD_GAUSSDB_NODE.ref_instanceId INNER JOIN CLOUD_VM_NOVA ON CLOUD_GAUSSDB_NODE.ref_vmbmsId = CLOUD_VM_NOVA.id
SELECT name, providerNetworkType, providerPhysicalNetworkSegId FROM CLOUD_NETWORK
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM CLOUD_NETWORK
SELECT vdcName, COUNT(*) AS count FROM CLOUD_FLOATING_IPS GROUP BY vdcName

SELECT DISTINCT CLOUD_ELB.name AS elb_name, CLOUD_ELB.id AS elb_id, CLOUD_LISTENER.name AS listener_name, CLOUD_LISTENER.protocol AS listener_protocol, CLOUD_LISTENER.port AS listener_port FROM CLOUD_ELB INNER JOIN CLOUD_LISTENER ON CLOUD_ELB.id = CLOUD_LISTENER.elbId

SELECT DISTINCT CLOUD_ELB.name AS elb_name, CLOUD_LISTENER.name AS listener_name, CLOUD_LISTENER.protocol AS protocol, CLOUD_LISTENER.port AS port FROM CLOUD_ELB INNER JOIN CLOUD_LISTENER ON CLOUD_ELB.id = CLOUD_LISTENER.elbId
SELECT DISTINCT CLOUD_LISTENER.name AS listener_name, CLOUD_LISTENER.protocol AS protocol, CLOUD_LISTENER.port AS port FROM CLOUD_ELB INNER JOIN CLOUD_LISTENER ON CLOUD_ELB.id = CLOUD_LISTENER.elbId
SELECT DISTINCT CLOUD_ELB.name AS elb_name, CLOUD_FLOATING_IPS.floatingIpAddress AS floating_ip FROM CLOUD_ELB INNER JOIN CLOUD_FLOATING_IPS ON CLOUD_ELB.ip = CLOUD_FLOATING_IPS.fixedIpAddress
SELECT CLOUD_LISTENER.protocol AS protocol, COUNT(*) AS count FROM CLOUD_ELB INNER JOIN CLOUD_LISTENER ON CLOUD_ELB.id = CLOUD_LISTENER.elbId GROUP BY CLOUD_LISTENER.protocol

SELECT CLOUD_PORT.name AS port_name, CLOUD_PORT.mac AS mac, CLOUD_PORT.ipAddresses AS ip, CLOUD_SUBNET.cidr AS subnet_cidr, CLOUD_SUBNET.gatewayIp AS gateway FROM CLOUD_VM_NOVA INNER JOIN CLOUD_PORT ON CLOUD_VM_NOVA.resId = CLOUD_PORT.devId INNER JOIN R_PORT_IN_SUBNET ON CLOUD_PORT.id = R_PORT_IN_SUBNET.portId INNER JOIN CLOUD_SUBNET ON R_PORT_IN_SUBNET.subnetId = CLOUD_SUBNET.id

SELECT DISTINCT CLOUD_SECURITY_GROUP.name AS sg_name FROM CLOUD_VM_NOVA INNER JOIN CLOUD_PORT ON CLOUD_VM_NOVA.resId = CLOUD_PORT.devId INNER JOIN R_PORT_USE_SECURITY_GROUP ON CLOUD_PORT.id = R_PORT_USE_SECURITY_GROUP.portId INNER JOIN CLOUD_SECURITY_GROUP ON R_PORT_USE_SECURITY_GROUP.sgId = CLOUD_SECURITY_GROUP.id

SELECT CLOUD_PORT.name AS port_name, CLOUD_PORT.mac AS mac, CLOUD_PORT.ipAddresses AS ip FROM CLOUD_SUBNET INNER JOIN R_PORT_IN_SUBNET ON CLOUD_SUBNET.id = R_PORT_IN_SUBNET.subnetId INNER JOIN CLOUD_PORT ON R_PORT_IN_SUBNET.portId = CLOUD_PORT.id

SELECT DISTINCT CLOUD_PORT.name AS port_name, CLOUD_PORT.id AS port_id, CLOUD_VM_NOVA.name AS vm_name, CLOUD_VM_NOVA.privateIps AS vm_ip FROM CLOUD_SECURITY_GROUP INNER JOIN R_PORT_USE_SECURITY_GROUP ON CLOUD_SECURITY_GROUP.id = R_PORT_USE_SECURITY_GROUP.sgId INNER JOIN CLOUD_PORT ON R_PORT_USE_SECURITY_GROUP.portId = CLOUD_PORT.id INNER JOIN CLOUD_VM_NOVA ON CLOUD_PORT.devId = CLOUD_VM_NOVA.resId
SELECT tenantName, status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM CLOUD_FLOATING_IPS GROUP BY tenantName, status
SELECT name AS subnet_name, cidr AS subnet_cidr FROM CLOUD_SUBNET
SELECT COUNT(*) AS subnet_count, cidr AS subnet_cidr FROM CLOUD_SUBNET GROUP BY cidr
SELECT name AS subnet_name, cidr AS subnet_cidr FROM CLOUD_SUBNET
SELECT CLOUD_NET_NODE.name AS node_name, CLOUD_NET_NODE.ipAddress AS ip_address, CLOUD_NET_NODE.managedStatus AS status, CLOUD_NET_NODE.serviceType AS service_type FROM CLOUD_NET_NODE
SELECT name, status FROM CLOUD_VFW
SELECT name, engineName, engineVersion, haMode, flavorCode FROM CLOUD_GAUSSDB_INSTANCE
SELECT engineVersion, COUNT(*) AS count FROM CLOUD_GAUSSDB_INSTANCE GROUP BY engineVersion
SELECT haMode, COUNT(*) AS count FROM CLOUD_GAUSSDB_INSTANCE GROUP BY haMode
SELECT engineVersion, haMode, flavorCode FROM CLOUD_GAUSSDB_INSTANCE
SELECT name, engineVersion, dataVip FROM CLOUD_GAUSSDB_INSTANCE

SELECT CLOUD_GAUSSDB_INSTANCE.name AS instance_name, CLOUD_HOST.name AS host_name, CLOUD_GAUSSDB_INSTANCE.tenantName AS tenant_name FROM CLOUD_GAUSSDB_INSTANCE INNER JOIN CLOUD_GAUSSDB_NODE ON CLOUD_GAUSSDB_INSTANCE.id = CLOUD_GAUSSDB_NODE.ref_instanceId INNER JOIN CLOUD_VM_NOVA ON CLOUD_GAUSSDB_NODE.ref_vmbmsId = CLOUD_VM_NOVA.id INNER JOIN CLOUD_HOST ON CLOUD_VM_NOVA.hostId = CLOUD_HOST.id
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM CLOUD_MIDDLEWARE_CLUSTER
SELECT managedStatus, COUNT(*) AS count FROM CLOUD_MIDDLEWARE GROUP BY managedStatus
SELECT engineVersion, COUNT(*) AS count FROM CLOUD_GAUSSDB_INSTANCE GROUP BY engineVersion UNION ALL SELECT type, COUNT(*) AS count FROM CLOUD_MIDDLEWARE GROUP BY type

SELECT DISTINCT CLOUD_CCE_NODE.name AS node_name, CLOUD_CCE_NODE.privateIP AS node_ip, CLOUD_CCE_NODE.status AS status FROM CLOUD_CCE_CLUSTER INNER JOIN CLOUD_CCE_NODE ON CLOUD_CCE_CLUSTER.id = CLOUD_CCE_NODE.ref_clusterId
SELECT DISTINCT CLOUD_CCE_WORKLOAD.name AS workload_name, CLOUD_CCE_WORKLOAD.managedStatus AS status FROM CLOUD_CCE_WORKLOAD
SELECT DISTINCT CLOUD_CCE_POD.name AS pod_name, CLOUD_CCE_POD.managedStatus AS status FROM CLOUD_CCE_CLUSTER INNER JOIN CLOUD_CCE_POD ON CLOUD_CCE_CLUSTER.nativeId = CLOUD_CCE_POD.clusterId

SELECT DISTINCT CLOUD_CCE_NODE.name AS node_name, CLOUD_CCE_NODE.managedStatus AS status, CLOUD_CCE_NODE.cpu AS cpu FROM CLOUD_CCE_CLUSTER INNER JOIN CLOUD_CCE_NODE ON CLOUD_CCE_CLUSTER.nativeId = CLOUD_CCE_NODE.clusterId

SELECT DISTINCT CLOUD_MODELARTS_INF_SERVICE.name AS service_name, CLOUD_MODELARTS_INF_POOL.name AS pool_name, CLOUD_MODELARTS_INF_NODE.name AS node_name FROM CLOUD_MODELARTS_INF_SERVICE INNER JOIN CLOUD_MODELARTS_INF_POOL ON CLOUD_MODELARTS_INF_SERVICE.ref_poolId = CLOUD_MODELARTS_INF_POOL.id INNER JOIN CLOUD_MODELARTS_INF_NODE ON CLOUD_MODELARTS_INF_POOL.id = CLOUD_MODELARTS_INF_NODE.ref_poolId

SELECT DISTINCT CLOUD_MODELARTS_INF_MODEL.name AS model_name, CLOUD_MODELARTS_TRAINING_JOB.name AS training_job_name FROM CLOUD_MODELARTS_INF_MODEL INNER JOIN CLOUD_MODELARTS_TRAINING_JOB ON CLOUD_MODELARTS_INF_MODEL.ref_trainingJobId = CLOUD_MODELARTS_TRAINING_JOB.id
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM CLOUD_MODELARTS_INF_SERVICE GROUP BY status

SELECT CLOUD_ApplicationModule.name AS module_name, CLOUD_ApplicationModule.status AS status FROM CLOUD_Application INNER JOIN CLOUD_ApplicationModule ON CLOUD_Application.id = CLOUD_ApplicationModule.appId

SELECT DISTINCT CLOUD_ApplicationModule.name AS module_name, CLOUD_ApplicationModuleIns.name AS instance_name FROM CLOUD_Application INNER JOIN CLOUD_ApplicationModule ON CLOUD_Application.id = CLOUD_ApplicationModule.appId INNER JOIN CLOUD_ApplicationModuleIns ON CLOUD_ApplicationModule.id = CLOUD_ApplicationModuleIns.appModuleId

SELECT CLOUD_ApplicationModuleIns.name AS instance_name, CLOUD_ApplicationModule.name AS module_name FROM CLOUD_Application INNER JOIN CLOUD_ApplicationModule ON CLOUD_Application.id = CLOUD_ApplicationModule.appId INNER JOIN CLOUD_ApplicationModuleIns ON CLOUD_ApplicationModule.id = CLOUD_ApplicationModuleIns.appModuleId

SELECT CLOUD_VM_NOVA.azoneName, CLOUD_VM_NOVA.name AS vm_name, CLOUD_VM_NOVA.privateIps AS ip, CLOUD_VM_NOVA.tenantName, CLOUD_CLUSTER.name AS cluster_name, CLOUD_HOST.name AS host_name FROM CLOUD_VM_NOVA LEFT JOIN CLOUD_CLUSTER ON CLOUD_VM_NOVA.clusterId = CLOUD_CLUSTER.id LEFT JOIN CLOUD_HOST ON CLOUD_VM_NOVA.hostId = CLOUD_HOST.id
SELECT vdcName, COUNT(*) AS ecs_count FROM CLOUD_VM_NOVA GROUP BY vdcName

SELECT CLOUD_ApplicationModuleIns.name AS instance_name, CLOUD_ApplicationModule.name AS module_name FROM CLOUD_Application INNER JOIN CLOUD_ApplicationModule ON CLOUD_Application.id = CLOUD_ApplicationModule.appId INNER JOIN CLOUD_ApplicationModuleIns ON CLOUD_ApplicationModule.id = CLOUD_ApplicationModuleIns.appModuleId

SELECT CLOUD_SUBNET.name AS subnet_name, CLOUD_SUBNET.cidr, COUNT(CLOUD_PORT.id) AS port_count FROM CLOUD_SUBNET LEFT JOIN R_PORT_IN_SUBNET ON CLOUD_SUBNET.id = R_PORT_IN_SUBNET.subnetId LEFT JOIN CLOUD_PORT ON CLOUD_PORT.id = R_PORT_IN_SUBNET.portId GROUP BY CLOUD_SUBNET.name, CLOUD_SUBNET.cidr ORDER BY port_count DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT CLOUD_VM_NOVA.name AS vm_name, CLOUD_VM_NOVA.tenantName AS tenant_name FROM CLOUD_VM_NOVA
SELECT name AS volume_name, size AS volume_size, status AS volume_status FROM CLOUD_VOLUME
SELECT COUNT(*) AS device_count FROM SYS_Device
SELECT COUNT(*) AS pool_count, SUM(totalCapacityGB) AS total_capacity, SUM(allocatedCapacityGB) AS allocated_capacity, SUM(freeCapacityGB) AS free_capacity FROM CLOUD_STORAGE_POOL
SELECT name AS host_name, ipAddress AS host_ip, status AS host_status FROM CLOUD_HOST
SELECT COUNT(*) AS gaussdb_count FROM CLOUD_GAUSSDB_INSTANCE
